svg.aria-label: Upper and lower limits of the thermal resistance of an inhomogeneous construction
svg.title: Upper and lower limits of the thermal resistance of an inhomogeneous construction

g.text: a · upper limit R′T: adiabatic planes
Each section is its own wall; no heat crosses
the section boundaries. Sections add in parallel:
b · lower limit R″T: isothermal planes
Each layer is averaged first; heat may move
sideways into the stud. Layers add in series:
R″T = R_si + Σ d_i / λ_mean,i + R_se (underestimates R)
ISO 6946 uses R_T = (R′T + R″T) / 2, valid while R′T / R″T ≤ 1.5.
Beyond that (steel studs, metal fixings) a numerical 2D or 3D calculation is required (ISO 10211).
